support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet explicitly instructs treating the registry link as unresolved.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; although billing records and registry row 3840192 share a similar name, name similarity is insufficient for identity, and the packet preserves multiple live candidates (including a Wyoming LLC) while stating the registry link cannot be established.
